radar.note: A flooded paddy is a mirror and comes back dark -- until the canopy closes, when the stems and the water surface form a dihedral and it comes back brighter than a drained field. The two responses cross, and around the crossing there is no information in VV at all. The detector says so instead of guessing.
caveats: Backscatter is simulated from the same hidden water state the optical series is drawn from; the detector never sees it.
The validation scores are against that simulation. Real validation needs field water-level loggers on a sample of plots.

methodology.name: Improved Management in Rice Production Systems
methodology.note: The purpose-built rice methodology, replacing CDM AMS-III.AU and CORSIA eligible. No buffer is withheld: avoided methane is not a stock and cannot reverse. The emission factor is still Tier 1 until local flux chambers calibrate it.

warnings: 62% of the projected volume is not safe to promise; a forward sale at the projection would be a short position

2 of 3 vintages clear nothing at 90% on their own, while the horizon as a whole clears 1 t: sell the period as a basket with a delivery window, not year by year. A slipped verification is only a miss when the contract names a single December
2 year(s) deliver nothing in more than a quarter of futures: 2026, 2027
forecast.risk_source: placeholder rates -- replace with the portfolio's own attrition, lapse and verification history

offtake_at_projection.verdict: do not sign: delivers in 31% of futures, so the likely outcome is buying 1 t on the spot market

forecast.note: Delivery is simulated against the risks that actually stop a credit arriving -- a farmer leaving, a season not practised, a planting failing, a verification slipping -- not just measurement error. The safe volume is the level cleared in nine futures out of ten, and it is what may be sold forward.
caveats: Attrition, lapse and verification rates are placeholders until the portfolio has its own history.
A single plot is one independently-failing unit, which is why the haircut is so large; the aggregation curve shows what that costs.

site.label: Gatugi shade-coffee block
site.intervention: Shade tree establishment at 120 stems/ha, pulp composting
site.notes: Coffee agroforestry is a removal pathway on land already under permanent crop, so tenure is cleaner than open reforestation and the shade trees earn their keep in timber and yield stability as well as carbon.

census.note: Both instruments read the same trees. The area-based path reads a stocking index off the canopy; the census counts stems, measures a sample and credits the lower bound of the survival survey. Only one of them works on a bund line, which is most of the agroforestry pipeline.
caveats: Survival and stem measurements are derived from the simulated canopy series, not from a field crew.
The allometric equation is generic: a local fit is worth roughly a quarter of the deduction.
The performance benchmark is a placeholder and no issuance may rest on it.

methodology.name: Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (area-based)
methodology.note: Credits are growth net of a dynamic performance benchmark. Both the benchmark and the allometric equation are placeholders.

warnings: 93% of the projected volume is not safe to promise; a forward sale at the projection would be a short position

15 of 15 vintages clear nothing at 90% on their own, while the horizon as a whole clears 31 t: sell the period as a basket with a delivery window, not year by year. A slipped verification is only a miss when the contract names a single December
forecast.risk_source: placeholder rates -- replace with the portfolio's own attrition, lapse and verification history

offtake_at_projection.verdict: do not sign: delivers in 15% of futures, so the likely outcome is buying 165 t on the spot market

forecast.note: Delivery is simulated against the risks that actually stop a credit arriving -- a farmer leaving, a season not practised, a planting failing, a verification slipping -- not just measurement error. The safe volume is the level cleared in nine futures out of ten, and it is what may be sold forward.
caveats: Attrition, lapse and verification rates are placeholders until the portfolio has its own history.
A single plot is one independently-failing unit, which is why the haircut is so large; the aggregation curve shows what that costs.

economics.note: Fixed cost is validation, verification, registry fees and project operations for one registered project, independent of how much land sits inside it.

deductions.basis: none: avoided methane is not a stock and cannot reverse, so the AFOLU non-permanence buffer does not apply
